svg.title: Storage Intelligence MCP and A2A Azure architecture
svg.desc: End-to-end architecture from authenticated clients through Container Apps, Microsoft Foundry, private Azure Functions, Private Link, and data services.
svg.text: Storage Intelligence — MCP & A2A Azure Architecture
Two request lanes make execution explicit; support panels document private networking, managed identity, RBAC, delivery, and monitoring.
Sweden Central | Infrastructure as Code: Bicep
1 Send request | 2 Authenticate | 3 Route REST, MCP, or A2A | 4 Query or persist in Cosmos DB
A Select agent tool | B Invoke Foundry agent | C Call private Function tool and dependencies
vnet-storage-intel-nladau77 | 192.168.0.0/16 | Private Link and Private DNS
User-assigned managed identities, least-privilege RBAC, delivery, and monitoring

text.tspan: ADLS Gen2 lake + Azure Key Vault
App Insights + Log Analytics through AMPLS
VNet-linked zones resolve Foundry, Search, Cosmos, Storage, ACR,
Functions, Key Vault, Durable Task, and Azure Monitor to private endpoints.
No inbound access to Function tools
Foundry User + AcrPull + Function Website Contributor
Key Vault Secrets User + Durable Task Contributor

g.text: Blue 1–4: primary UI, MCP, and A2A request path
Purple A–C: optional Foundry tool path
Panels below: controls and placement, not additional request hops

svg.text: Source of truth: Bicep, application code, and deployed rg-storage-intel-mcpa2a topology
